flavor_text.sun-moon: A medicine that can revive fainted Pokémon. It also fully restores a fainted Pokémon’s maximum HP.
flavor_text.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: A medicine that can revive fainted Pokémon. It also fully restores a fainted Pokémon’s maximum HP.
flavor_text.lets-go-pikachu-lets-go-eevee: A medicine that can be used to revive a single Pokémon that has fainted. It also fully restores the Pokémon’s max HP.
